newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Consolidada to lift Venezuela's La Seguridad stake.
newsitem.headline: Consolidada to lift Venezuela's La Seguridad stake.

text.p: Venezuela's Consolidada Carabobo SACA, a holding group for construction materials companies, said it will raise its stake in Venezuela's largest insurance company Seguros La Seguridad to about 17 percent, the Caracas Stock Exchange announced Monday.

Consolidada will buy 212,479,780 shares of Inversiones e Seguros y Reaseguros (INVERSERCA) and 8,001,086 shares of Seguros La Seguridad for 992,163,897 bolivars ($2.1 million) from H.L. Boulton and Co SACA.
After taking into account its current holdings in La Seguridad, Consolidada will become the owner of 17.0395 percent of the insurance company's stock, the exchange said in a daily report.
